Inspired by the band [Cake](https://www.cakemusic.com/forest-2019-20), Van Galen Lab alumni will get a plant and be placed on a map according to their next adventure.

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| warning: false

library(tidyverse)
library(leaflet)
library(leaflet.extras)

# Alumni data with coordinates
alumni_data <- tribble(
  ~name, ~position, ~lat, ~lng, ~image_path,
  "Marina Ainciburu", "Marina went back to finish her graduate work at the University of Navarra in 2021.", 42.80160198534935, -1.6592108889039419, "images/people/Marina_Ainciburu.jpg",
  "Jean Acosta", "Jean went to work at bluebird bio in 2021.", 42.36516686902243, -71.07953954532121, "images/people/Jean_Acosta.png",
  "Jenny Noel", "Jenny went to pursue her Nursing degree at MGH and BWH in 2022.", 42.33638598770364, -71.10670861471547, "images/people/Jenny_Noel.jpg",
  "Feyza Canan", "Feyza returned to Medical School in Ankara after her 2022 summer internship.", 39.92538859206633, 32.78472660149568, "images/people/Feyza_Canan.jpeg",
  "Erica DePasquale", "Erica left the lab in 2022 and is now an Assistant Professor at Cincinnati Children's Hospital.", 39.14057493497279, -84.5008852422916, "images/people/Erica_DePasquale.jpg",
  "Daniel Ssozi", "Daniel started the Albert Einstein MD/PhD program in 2023.", 40.85069895841855, -73.84593438929224, "images/people/Daniel_Ssozi.jpeg",
  "Kyle Romine", "Kyle went to head a team investigating antibody-drug conjugates at Seagen in 2023.", 47.8015492611432,  -122.19353231534235, "images/people/Kyle_Romine.jpg",
  "Sarah Bibeau", "Sarah started her graduate program at Boston College in 2023.", 42.33569142415681, -71.16841244281315, "images/people/Sarah_Bibeau.jpg",
  "Nurefsan Saripek", "Nurefsan started her residency at Yale School of Medicine in 2025.", 41.30340404108865, -72.93388313754483, "images/people/Nurefsan_Sariipek.jpg",
  "Noha Awais", "Noha started as a medical student at Harvard Medical School in 2025.", 42.33571930804914, -71.10421707057944, "images/people/Noha_Awais.jpg"
)

# Create the map
alumni_data %>%
  leaflet() %>%
  addProviderTiles(providers$CartoDB.Voyager) %>%
  setView(lng = 0, lat = 20, zoom = 2) %>%
  addCircleMarkers(
    ~lng, ~lat,
    radius = 6,
    color = "black",
    weight = 1,
    fillColor = "#18bc9c",
    fillOpacity = 0.8,
    popup = ~str_c(
        "<div style='text-align: left; width: 180px;'>",
        "<img src='", image_path, "' alt='", name, "' style='width: 150px; height: 150px; object-fit: cover;'>",
        "<h4 style='margin: 5px 0;'>", name, "</h4>",
        "<p style='margin: 5px 0;'>", position, "</p>",
        "</div>"
)
  ) %>%
  addResetMapButton()
```
